title: FreeAgent Launches New Amazon Integration Feature
description: FreeAgent now integrates with Amazon, offering a hassle-free solution to managing e-commerce finances.
author: Barry Adams
html:
FreeAgent has introduced an exciting new integration feature aimed at streamlining the bookkeeping of online sellers. This latest development allows users to seamlessly integrate their Amazon transactions directly into the FreeAgent platform, offering a hassle-free solution to managing e-commerce finances.

What is FreeAgent?

FreeAgent is an award-winning accounting software, trusted by over 150,000 business owners, designed specifically for small businesses and landlords.

With a user-friendly interface and powerful features, FreeAgent enables users to effortlessly handle their daily administrative tasks and gain valuable insights into their finances.

From expense management to invoicing, time tracking, and tax submissions, FreeAgent provides comprehensive support to businesses across the UK.

Why Use FreeAgent?

Named the UK's #1 bookkeeping software for small businesses, FreeAgent offers numerous benefits to its users:

Bank Feeds:

By automatically importing all business transactions into the FreeAgent account, users are spared the tedious task of manual data entry.

Setting up bank feeds is effortless, but what really sets FreeAgent apart is its integration of machine learning, leveraging AI to automatically categorise transactions. As the system learns from user interactions, it becomes increasingly adept at accurately categorizing transactions over time.

Mobile App:

FreeAgent's mobile app offers convenient business account management on the fly. Users can easily snap photos of receipts, record expenses, and even start timers for billable hours—all from their smartphones.

With features like SmartCapture for extracting receipt information and access to your business bank account on the go, the app ensures efficient financial tracking wherever you find yourself.

Introducing Amazon Integration

Building upon its ever-expanding set of features, FreeAgent has introduced an Amazon integration feature tailored to the needs of e-commerce sellers. Key highlights of this integration include:

  • Automated Categorisation:

Upon setup, the integration automatically categorises sales income and Amazon fees within FreeAgent, eliminating manual data entry tasks.

  • Seamless Integration:

Developed in-house, the integration seamlessly operates within the FreeAgent platform, eliminating the need for additional software and ensuring a smooth user experience.

  • Cost-Effective Solution:

Unlike third-party alternatives, FreeAgent offers a single pricing model for its integration, irrespective of the volume of data processed, providing cost savings for users.

  • International Reach:

In response to user demand, FreeAgent has extended its Amazon integration to include overseas marketplaces, allowing users to efficiently manage international sales. Sellers with an Amazon UK Marketplace account can now connect the integration to handle transactions from global marketplaces.

If you want to benefit from this all new feature then you’re in luck! It is available at an affordable monthly rate of £6 (+VAT).

Take Advantage Today

For businesses looking to optimise their e-commerce finances, FreeAgent presents a compelling solution. Moreover, users can access FreeAgent for free by maintaining a business bank account with NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland, or Ulster Bank, or by conducting at least one transaction per month through a Mettle bank account.

In conclusion, FreeAgent's new Amazon integration feature represents a significant advancement in simplifying financial management for online sellers. By leveraging the platform's intuitive interface and powerful capabilities, businesses can streamline their operations, gain valuable insights, and focus on what they do best – growing their enterprise.
